findings.passage: TN has very good voting laws and practices. I would, however, reduce the number of days early voting is available.
findings.note: Candidate questionnaire answer (2022 general-election cycle, State Rep. Dist. 35) to the prompt 'What laws would you propose to change present voting practices?'. On the same questionnaire he marked 'Strongly Disagree' to the statement 'People should be able to vote without photo identification.'
